items.requirement: Create one or more patch files in /root/patches/ that address the CVE-2021-25646 vulnerability.
items.source_quote: Write patch files that can address this vulnerability in `/root/patches/`
items.verification: A grader can verify this by confirming /root/patches/ exists and contains at least one *.patch file.

items.requirement: Apply the patch changes directly to the Druid source tree at /root/druid so the git working directory shows modified files.
items.source_quote: Apply your patches to the Druid source code (a git repository) at `/root/druid/`
items.verification: A grader can verify this by running `git diff --name-only` in /root/druid and confirming at least one file is listed as modified.

items.requirement: Rebuild Druid with Maven using the exact specified flags (skip tests, checkstyle, pmd, forbiddenapis, spotbugs, animal-sniffer, enforcer, jacoco, dependency-check, and exclude web-console) so that a valid indexing-service module JAR is produced.
items.source_quote: Rebuild Druid with the fixes using Maven (skip web-console to avoid OOM error, skip code quality checks for patched files):
items.verification: A grader can verify this by running the given mvn command and confirming it exits successfully and that a druid-indexing-service-*.jar (and any other rebuilt module jars needed by the fix) exists under the corresponding target/ directory.
items.notes: The verifier's test.sh separately searches /root/druid/{core,processing,server,indexing-service}/target for built jars to deploy; if the fix requires changes outside indexing-service, those modules must also be rebuilt so their jars exist.

items.requirement: The fix targets and is compatible with Apache Druid version 0.20.0 specifically (not a different version's codebase or a generic/unrelated patch).
items.source_quote: You must work with Apache Druid version 0.20.0.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by checking that /root/druid is checked out at (or otherwise corresponds to) the 0.20.0 release, e.g. via the root pom.xml version, and that the patch applies cleanly against that source.

items.requirement: Block the empty-key ("") JSON deserialization trick that overrides JavaScriptConfig, so that all tested CVE-2021-25646 exploit variants sent to /druid/indexer/v1/sampler with a javascript-type transformSpec filter fail to achieve remote code execution or bypass the disabled-JS setting.
items.source_quote: The empty key `""` can bypass JavaScript security settings to allow arbitrary code execution.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by sending each of the six exploit payload variants (id, whoami, hostname, /etc/passwd read, env dump, ProcessBuilder) to the patched, running Druid server and confirming none return RCE evidence (e.g. uid=, PATH=, /bin/bash) in a 200 response, and that the request is rejected or clearly blocked.

items.requirement: Ensure legitimate sampler requests that do not use a JavaScript filter continue to work correctly after the patch, i.e. the fix must not be an overly broad block of the entire /druid/indexer/v1/sampler endpoint.
items.source_quote: Tests will verify that all exploit requests are blocked while legitimate requests still work.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by sending a legitimate JSON-format (non-JavaScript) sampler request to the patched, running Druid server and confirming the response is not incorrectly rejected with a JavaScript-disabled/blocked/not-allowed message.
